audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was marked Renekton while spikes[0], early and whys[0] all say the opposite — 'At level 1 you own this because he has no fury yet', 'you own the attrition war from the start'. Level 3 was marked Singed while whys[2] calls it 'a neutral window'.
audit.why: Renekton starts with zero Fury and Ruthless Predator is not ranked until 2, so a moving Singed takes chip and gives none; by 3 both full kits are online and it is genuinely even. The packet chart reads Singed at 1 and Skill at 3.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: win[0] to Singed, win[2] to Skill, plus the matching phases sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was template filler with no numbers, and the level-6 spike never said how long his window lasts.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 falling to 8s at rank 5; Slice and Dice is 16s at rank 1; Cull the Meek is a flat 7s; Dominus is 120/100/80s. The 16s Ruthless Predator at rank 1 is enormous — a whiffed empowered W means the next 16 seconds are free proxy time.
audit.corrected: Real rank-1 numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions absent: Mega Adhesive grounds Slice and Dice, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts Cull the Meek's healing.
audit.why: Slice and Dice carries the dash flag, 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny', and Mega Adhesive grounds. The page's version — 'throw W ahead of him so Dice lands him into the sticky zone' — undersells it: glue on his feet means the recast does not fire and he cannot leave. Separately, Cull the Meek heals ('heals for a small portion of the damage dealt', more above 50 Fury) and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so his only sustain is cut for as long as he stands in the cloud. Neither was on the page.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into mid, wants.you[1] and dosFull[2]; the anti-heal written into whys[4] and spikes[2].

audit.why: Ruthless Predator is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. The page already tells you to keep moving so it whiffs; that advice is sound and stays.
audit.corrected: Left as found, with the reset named in dontsFull[1].

edits.before: You lose most level-1 duels — set up the proxy game instead. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He starts on zero Fury and has no Ruthless Predator yet — trail poison over his feet as he last-hits and keep walking, he cannot answer it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Renekton must walk into your range.
edits.after: Both full kits are online — neutral. Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1, so a whiff buys you free proxy time.

edits.before: Mega Adhesive plus Fling is fully assembled but Renekton also has his full combo, making this a neutral window decided by who trades on whose terms — run the pattern but don't overcommit.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive plus Fling is assembled but so is his full combo — neutral, decided by who trades on whose terms. Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1: punish the whiff, not the cast.

edits.before: Dominus gives Renekton real HP and constant fury generation — he can sustain short cloud exposures and all-in you, so use Ghost to disengage and wait for Insanity Potion to even the stat trade.
edits.after: Dominus gives Renekton real HP and constant fury to all-in you — Ghost out, then re-engage with Insanity Potion up, because its Grievous Wounds cuts the Cull the Meek healing he is relying on.

edits.before: Renekton's ult swells his HP and grants fury generation, giving him a real window to all-in you — Ghost and respect the empowered W stun until Insanity Potion is back up.
edits.after: Renekton's Dominus swells his HP and generates fury, a real all-in window — Ghost out and come back with Insanity Potion, whose Grievous Wounds guts his Cull the Meek sustain.

edits.before: At level 4 start proxying: run past the wave toward his tower, drop Poison Trail on the caster minions behind his line, and force him to decide between losing the proxy farm or chasing you into Mega Adhesive range. When he dashes with Slice to chase, immediately throw W ahead of him so Dice lands him into the sticky zone, then Fling him back toward your tower and keep running — he is now behind you, poisoned, rooted, and facing your tower. Level 6 is the one window you genuinely respect: Renekton's Dominus gives him the HP and fury generation to sustain through short cloud exposures and all-in, so pop Ghost and back off when you see the red cloud. Wait for Insanity Potion to match him and re-engage.
edits.after: At level 4 start proxying: run past the wave toward his tower, drop Poison Trail on the caster minions behind his line, and force him to decide between losing the proxy farm or chasing you into Mega Adhesive range. When he slices in to chase, drop the glue on his feet — grounding shuts Slice and Dice off, so the second dash never fires and he cannot leave; Fling him back toward your tower and keep running with him poisoned and stranded behind you. Level 6 is the one window you genuinely respect: Renekton's Dominus gives him the HP and fury generation to sustain through short cloud exposures and all-in, so pop Ghost and back off when you see the red cloud. Re-engage with Insanity Potion up — its Grievous Wounds cuts his Cull the Meek healing.

edits.before: Use Mega Adhesive to root him when he dashes in, then Fling him back into the cloud toward your tower
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive on his feet as he slices in — grounding stops the second dash — then Fling him

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Keep moving. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator: 16s at rank 1, 8s maxed — empowered is a 1.5s stun. Punish the whiff. - Slice and Dice: 16s at rank 1, and glue grounds it. - Cull the Meek: 7s, healing, so Grievous Wounds matters. - Dominus: 120s.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds Slice and Dice — the second cast does not fire at all.
Stand still for his W reset

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue.

edits.before: Survive his early — proxy + kite, out-scale him. Singed wins the Ruthless Predator cooldown windows.
edits.after: Proxy + kite, glue grounds Slice and Dice. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds guts his Q heal.

notes: MISFIRED DERIVED FLAG: champ-data/_kits/_missing/singed.json says "Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W) absorbs your burst window — force it out before you commit", and the kit's W carries a 'shield' flag. Riot's description says the opposite: empowered Ruthless Predator DESTROYS damage shields on the target. It gives Renekton no shield. That headline was not written to the page. packet suspectNames (Poison Trail, Mega Adhesive) are false positives. Level-chart flip proposed as one atomic group.
